name: Sam Townsend
bio: Sam Townsend was a freighter who in October 1884 hauled 50,000 pounds from Medora to Deadwood in seven days, which the paper called the fastest time ever from the Northern Pacific. He took charge of another man's mule train in 1885 and hauled for the stage company, and by October 1885 he was grading on the Northwestern's branch from Chadron toward the Black Hills.
